enabled.label: Messages to customers
enabled.help: The master switch. Off: no SMS, WhatsApp or e-mail goes to any customer; every planned message is logged as skipped. Until a provider's key is entered, each channel runs on its mock and the log says "would send".

journey.label: Order journey
journey.help: For each step of an order (received, self-confirm, confirmed, packed, booked, out for delivery, delivery day, delivered, Day-1 care, Day-3 review) and each notice (cancelled — with the reason, see Cancellation notice — cancel request refused, on hold, advance asked, gift receiver): on or off, the channel and a fallback, also by e-mail, when it goes (at once, minutes later, or at a time some days later), which orders (all, cash on delivery, prepaid) and its template. A step never goes twice for one order.

caps.label: Caps per order
caps.help: At most this many messages of the order journey per order on each channel, and in total (empty = no cap). A message over a cap is not sent and the log says why. The Day-1 and Day-3 follow-ups and the notices are outside the caps.

selfConfirm.label: WhatsApp self-confirm
selfConfirm.help: Switched on in the order journey (step "Self-confirm", off). Here: only a customer's first order, the hours to wait for a reply before the order goes to the call queue (0 = no call for a missing reply), whether his 1 confirms the order (on; not while a duplicate review, a cancel request or an advance is open), and whether it is the order's one WhatsApp (then the "packed" WhatsApp does not go).

language.label: Message language
language.help: The language of the messages: the language the customer ordered in (as shipped; the store's language when an order has none), the store's language, or always Bengali, or always English.

quietHours.label: Quiet hours
quietHours.help: Off by default. When on, a message that falls between these hours (the store's time) waits until they end. The "order received" message is never held.

amountLine.label: Amount line
amountLine.help: The {amountLine} of a template: the amount still to pay (total minus what is paid). A fully paid order gets no amount line at all.

exactAmount.label: Exact-amount line
exactAmount.help: The {exactAmountLine} of a template, sent only while "Exact amount for the rider" is on (the order page settings): the words when money is still due, and the words for a fully paid order. {link} is the order's page.

engine.label: Message engine
engine.help: How often the worker plans and sends messages (seconds), how far back it reads the order timeline (a step older than this is never sent late, minutes) and how many messages it handles at a time.

retry.label: Retries
retry.help: When a sender fails, the message is tried again after each wait in turn (minutes; the last wait repeats), up to this many tries in all. Then it is marked failed, shown in the message log, and the step's fallback channel is tried. A number the channel cannot reach (not on WhatsApp) is not retried. Staff may retry a failed message once more by hand.

pageSize.label: Message log page size
pageSize.help: How many messages one page of the message log shows.

cancelNotice.label: Cancellation notice
cancelNotice.help: What the "cancelled" step of the order journey tells the customer (switch the step on there; off when shipped). Its template's {cancelReason} is the reason in plain words for each cancel reason; a reason without words says nothing, and the team's own note is never sent. Silent reasons send nothing at all (shipped: declined as fake, and someone else used his number). A duplicate cancelled while his other order goes ahead gets the duplicate template, with that order's number and tracking link. The notice is outside the caps and never goes twice.

masking.label: SMS masking name
masking.help: The shop's name an SMS comes from instead of a number (up to 11 letters or digits). Ask the SMS gateway for it, then mark here where it stands: not asked, asked, approved or refused. Only once it is approved (and "use it" is on) does every SMS go from the name; until then from the gateway's own number.

rates.label: Price of one SMS part
rates.help: What the gateway charges for one SMS part, with the masking name and without it. Empty = not known: the message log then shows no cost. A long or Bengali SMS takes more parts (the template editor shows how many).

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp Business templates
whatsapp.help: How the shop's WhatsApp texts go to Meta for approval: the language code for each language (Bengali bn, English en), the category (order updates are UTILITY), the largest webhook message read (KB) and for how many hours a customer's 1, 2 or 3 still answers the self-confirm question. A message the shop starts goes only as an approved template once WhatsApp is live.

consent.label: Consent and stop words
consent.help: A customer who replies with a stop word (STOP, UNSUBSCRIBE, বন্ধ …) gets no more messages on that channel; a start word takes it back. Choose whether a stop covers every message or only offers, the channel he wrote on or every channel, which journey steps are offers (sent only to a customer who ticked yes), and whether the stop is answered. A stop is always honoured.

autoReply.label: Auto-reply
autoReply.help: When a customer writes to the shop on WhatsApp (anything but a 1, 2, 3 answer or a stop word), he gets a short answer: the template, once in so many hours for his number, always or only outside the shop's hours. A customer who stopped messages gets nothing. Off as it ships.
